name: HC42a:  GMH
description:
Number of clients whose first documented enrollment into a Differentiated Service Delivery Model during the reporting period was Group Models managed by Health Workers.
The client must have a dsdm_models record between :startDate and :endDate, the recorded model must be GMH: Group models managed by HCW, and there must be no earlier record for the same patient with a non-null DSDM model.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'GMH: Group models managed by HCW'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime < h.encounter_datetime
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'GMH: Group models managed by HCW'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime < h.encounter_datetime
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  );
